About Rozmajzl Twins
The Rozmajzl Twins, Ella and Emma Rozmajzl, are American social media influencers and models born on October 27, 2007, in Atlanta, Georgia. They grew up in a large family with five sisters—Victoria Rozmajzl, Katerina Rozmajzl, Marianna Rozmajzl , Alexi Rozmajzl —and their parents, Ken Rozmajzl and Leanne Billington Rozmajzl. Their early life was spent in Georgia. The twins are of Czech descent, reflecting their family’s heritage, and hold American nationality.

Their modeling and social media careers began as extensions of their family’s growing online presence. They have modeled for Roz Avenue, a clothing brand associated with their family, featuring casual and trendy styles. Their social media activity started gaining attention through collaborative posts with their sisters, showcasing their involvement in fashion and lifestyle content.

On TikTok, the twins share the account @ellaandemma, where they post dance videos, lip-syncs, and family-oriented content. As of March 2025, their account has over 1 million followers, reflecting their popularity among a young audience. Their videos often highlight their twin dynamic, adding a relatable and engaging element to their presence.

The Rozmajzl Twins are key contributors to the “Rozmajzl Sisters” YouTube channel, launched in 2015, where they appear alongside their siblings in vlogs, challenges, and lifestyle videos. The channel has over 38,000 subscribers, though they do not maintain separate individual accounts. On Instagram, Ella (@ella.rozmajzl) and Emma (@emma.rozmajzl) each have over 100,000 followers, sharing modeling photos, family moments, and glimpses of their daily lives, often mirroring each other’s content as twins.

Physically, Ella and Emma are approximately 5 feet 8 inches (160 cm) tall, with slim builds typical of their age and modeling roles and much shorter than their sisters' who range from 5 feet 11 to 6 feet 1. Although they are much taller than the average American woman. They have blonde hair and blue eyes, consistent with their sisters’ features, presenting a youthful and symmetrical appearance. The both have C cup breasts. There is no confirmed information indicating they have undergone cosmetic surgeries on their breasts, lips, buttocks, nose, or other areas, nor have they disclosed having tattoos or piercings, aligning with their clean-cut public persona.

Fans, including male followers, often admire the twins for their matching looks, blonde hair, and blue eyes, which emphasize their twin identity. Their “cute” and “pretty” appearance is frequently noted in comments, with their youthful energy and coordinated style highlighted as appealing traits. Their petite frames and identical features are commonly praised, reinforcing their charm. What makes them unique is their twin status, which they leverage to create synchronized content, setting them apart in the crowded influencer space while maintaining a strong family brand.

Their income is derived from social media sponsorships, modeling for Roz Avenue, and family collaborations. While individual net worth estimates are not widely available, their collective earnings as part of the Rozmajzl family likely fall within the range of $100,000 to $500,000 USD, though these figures are speculative and unverified.

Currently, Ella and Emma continue to live and attend school in Georgia, focusing on their education while growing their social media presence. They remain active on TikTok and Instagram, collaborating with their sisters and promoting Roz Avenue, with plans to expand their influence as they approach adulthood.
